snapshot.scope: Independent Product Planning review of the first PIGE-DATA-003 Managed Collection interface: one imported Dataset opens under the same identity; one non-formula scalar edit and Activity Undo create immutable CAS-fenced revisions/Operations; originals, SourceRecord import evidence and historical previews remain unchanged; statuses remain unchanged.

reviewers.independence: Product Planning reviewed Dataset durability, IPC, Activity/Undo, UI and phase owners against the existing import/query implementation; Development and UI own the separate service, preload, renderer and focused-test implementation.

dimensions.summary: One Dataset identity and manifest select immutable revision payloads; source evidence, prior revisions and historical previews remain intact.
Data, API, Job and UI agree on exact revision CAS, scalar edit bounds, manifest-switch-last and forward-only Undo.
B7.10 records only the bounded foundation while E7.06 and PIGE-DATA-003 remain open without status promotion.
Canonical schemas name the two channels, safe projections, result states, revision changes and Activity target needed for parallel Development/UI work.
Existing Dataset, API, recovery, UI, phase and decision owners bind one vertical slice without a new document or broader Collection framework.

verification.evidence: Collection open/edit schemas, revision-fenced Activity/Undo vocabulary and body/path/SQL-free ownership remain canonical.

verification.command: npm run verify:docs && npm run verify:decisions
verification.evidence: Dataset, API, recovery, UI, phase and accepted-decision owners pass without a new document.
Canonical schemas/contracts compile while preload and implementation remain a separate parallel slice.

coordination.compatibility: Legacy initial payloads remain readable; new mutations use unique revision payloads and leave SourceRecord initial-import evidence, originals and historical previews unchanged.
coordination.acknowledgement: Planning binds open, one scalar-cell edit and forward-only Activity Undo only; formulas, views, relations, CRUD and remaining PIGE-DATA-003 acceptance stay planned.

nonBlockingRisks: Development must prove manifest-last recovery, exact request adoption, stale CAS and Operation repair with focused synthetic Dataset fixtures.
UI must prove keyboard editing, stale reload, read-only formula/unsupported cells and Activity Undo without changing historical previews.
Fields, rows, formulas, views, relations, bulk edits, redo and external-source writes remain outside this slice.
